query: What steps should an organization follow to implement the AI RMF?
answer: Organizations should: (1) assess current AI risk practices, (2) establish governance structures (GOVERN), (3) map AI systems and their contexts (MAP), (4) develop measurement approaches and metrics (MEASURE), (5) implement risk response strategies (MANAGE), (6) document and communicate decisions, and (7) continuously iterate across all four functions as the AI system evolves.
